fc4f31acc215e98ba1494d4340ca959f4b49491c.title: Open referenced Public Acts
fc4f31acc215e98ba1494d4340ca959f4b49491c.summary: Public Act references from 1991 onward now link to the General Assembly’s act lookup from statute text, source notes, and history.

5eb9d2509ff977316e301be43bb1072d28f2bb8b.title: Follow every citation in a range or list
5eb9d2509ff977316e301be43bb1072d28f2bb8b.summary: Both ends of ranges such as “10-409 to 10-415” are now clickable, along with additional section and chapter references in lists.

db82e16efd882b8fd06ad004f335e3bdde161c90.title: More reliable navigation and recovery
db82e16efd882b8fd06ad004f335e3bdde161c90.summary: Rapid navigation now keeps the selected page in view. Failed data requests can be retried, and offline operations are coordinated to protect downloaded data.

b05fe32728266704a94d415d75c60b84ed6a982d.title: See which release you’re using
b05fe32728266704a94d415d75c60b84ed6a982d.summary: The About page displays the site’s release version and links to its GitHub release notes.

f7fa56f46d0cc8a1e4a66c2963a745c40774a62e.title: Stronger offline reliability
f7fa56f46d0cc8a1e4a66c2963a745c40774a62e.summary: Downloaded data is checked for integrity, and Settings provides storage, repair, and release information.

29bcba34294a52d4f2faa214224ff19a468487e1.title: More ways to search the statutes
29bcba34294a52d4f2faa214224ff19a468487e1.summary: Search supports Boolean and proximity queries, field filters, searching within results, and device-local search history.

f5b995719e9387f8de5a25db16f8f0e25c92a5ba.title: Accessibility checks before publication
f5b995719e9387f8de5a25db16f8f0e25c92a5ba.summary: Automated browser checks help catch accessibility and interface problems before updates are published.

34791777d74ef21e2ae0762e81d4a60bb1353b10.title: Refined statute browsing and search
34791777d74ef21e2ae0762e81d4a60bb1353b10.summary: Updated the statute navigation and search interface for easier browsing.
